english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the practice or system of serving yourself when buying or obtaining something.

examples.english: This supermarket runs on self-service, so you have to pay for your own purchases.
examples.traditional: 呢間超市行自助服務，買嘢要自己畀錢。
